title: Celeb-Beloved Chef Edo Baldi Opens New Steakhouse, Baldi, at Waldorf Astoria in Beverly Hills
summary: The second-generation restaurateur is best known for Tuscan-inspired A-list magnet e.baldi, on Canon Drive. Of the new place, he says, “It’s really going back to what the principle was for my father when he started, which was local dishes with simplicity done correctly. "
